//: Unit-test build: compiles src/ + tests/ to plain CommonJS that Node runs
directly under Bazel (node:test, no bundler, no test framework dep).
CJS is deliberate: tsc does not rewrite extensionless ESM import paths,
so emitted ESM would not resolve under Node — CJS require() does.
verbatimModuleSyntax must be off for ESM-syntax -> CJS emit; runtime
imports of @ledmapper/protocol never happen (types only, erased on emit).
